description: Audit signal quality across production data. Query mcp_signal_scores for each of the 8 signals and compute: (1) distinct score count per signal_type; (2) score range (min-max); (3) standard deviation. Signals with <5 distinct scores or stddev <5.0 are WEAK and need enrichment revision. Also verify each signal producer writes evidence_blob with signal_type, confidence, and evidence_blob keys matching spec section 3. Output: structured report logged and written to service_health.meta as JSON. Runs on 4h cycle via gate_scheduler.
